High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[End This Destructive Conflict (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (Cloud City, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/End This Destructive Conflict _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QZREpGPumx61cfAy-m_A-tf17e0UuUj4/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>End This Destructive Conflict _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,756 bytes, SHA-256 <code>cb0641c456622f05f52297f2c5c33c5bdc98462339f22f0e6cd587b798edef88</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.0, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:CC-D-endthisdestructiveconflict.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
